extracted.intended_audience: Researchers applying for CDMRP Breast Cancer Research Program (BCRP) funding; breast cancer investigators and program stakeholders
extracted.subtask_description: Program-level guidance describing the research priorities, mission, and overarching challenges that BCRP seeks in grant applications to end breast cancer. Intended to steer applicants toward high-impact, innovative, clinically relevant proposals aligned with CDMRP goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vision
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-level aspirational goal that frames program priorities; proposals should align with the ultimate vision of eliminating breast cancer's burden.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission
rubrics_metrics.description: To end breast cancer for Service Members and their Families, Veterans, and the general public by funding innovative, high-impact research through a partnership of scientists and consumers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the program will prioritize innovative, high-impact research with clinical relevance and stakeholder/consumer engagement; applicants should emphasize potential impact and relevance to Service members, veterans, and the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program goals: accelerate high-impact, clinically relevant research; encourage innovation and creativity; facilitate collaborations
rubrics_metrics.description: The BCRP seeks to accelerate high-impact research with clinical relevance, encourage innovation and stimulate creativity, and facilitate productive collaborations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications should demonstrate high potential impact, clinical relevance, novelty/innovation, creativity in approach, and plans for productive collaborations (multi-disciplinary or stakeholder partnerships).

rubrics_metrics.name: Read The Breast Cancer Landscape before applying
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants are strongly urged to read and consider The Breast Cancer Landscape before preparing their applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Breast Cancer Landscape describes current knowledge and areas of greatest need; aligning proposals with this landscape is recommended to improve relevance to BCRP priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prevent breast cancer (primary prevention)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals addressing mechanisms, interventions, or strategies that reduce breast cancer incidence are prioritized under prevention objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify determinants of breast cancer initiation, risk, or susceptibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify determinants of breast cancer initiation, risk, or susceptibility
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research that uncovers genetic, molecular, environmental, behavioral, or other determinants of initiation or susceptibility is sought; mechanistic or translational approaches that inform prevention/early detection are appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinguish deadly from non-deadly breast cancers
rubrics_metrics.description: Distinguish deadly from non-deadly breast cancers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work that identifies biomarkers, signatures, or mechanisms differentiating indolent versus lethal disease to guide treatment decisions and reduce overtreatment is prioritized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conquer the problems of overdiagnosis and overtreatment
rubrics_metrics.description: Conquer the problems of overdiagnosis and overtreatment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Studies that develop tools, criteria, or strategies to reduce unnecessary diagnosis and treatment (thereby improving quality of care and reducing harms) align with this challenge.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify what drives breast cancer growth; determine how to stop it
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify what drives breast cancer growth; determine how to stop it
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects that elucidate drivers of tumor growth and translate those findings into approaches to halt progression are in scope; both basic and translational studies relevant to stopping growth are acceptable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify why some breast cancers become metastatic
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify why some breast cancers become metastatic
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research aimed at mechanisms enabling metastasis, predictive markers of metastatic potential, or interventions to prevent metastatic spread are sought.

rubrics_metrics.name: Determine why/how breast cancer cells lie dormant for years and then re-emerge; determine how to prevent lethal recurrence
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine why/how breast cancer cells lie dormant for years and then re-emerge; determine how to prevent lethal recurrence
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work that addresses tumor dormancy biology, triggers of reactivation, and strategies to prevent recurrence—especially lethal recurrence—is prioritized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revolutionize treatment regimens: improve survival, be more effective, and be less toxic
rubrics_metrics.description: Revolutionize treatment regimens by replacing them with ones that do all of the following: improve survival, are more effective, and are less toxic
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should aim for substantive improvements over current therapies—demonstrable gains in survival, efficacy, and reductions in toxicity; therapeutic innovation and translational potential are emphasized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eliminate the mortality associated with metastatic breast cancer
rubrics_metrics.description: Eliminate the mortality associated with metastatic breast cancer
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-priority research directly targeting reduction/elimination of deaths from metastatic disease, including novel therapeutics, prevention of metastasis, and management strategies, is encouraged.
